x_food_processor_unit.lore.legendary: Chopped an onion so fast that the onion cried before the cook did, and now onions arrive with their own tissues.

x_hand_mixer.lore.epic: Was switched to top speed and danced itself out of the bowl, across the counter and into the sink, still whisking.
x_hand_mixer.lore.legendary: Whisked egg whites so stiff that the builders used the meringue to fix the garden wall.

x_ice_cream_maker.lore.epic: Churned so hard at a street party that it froze the paddling pool next door, and the children went ice-skating in July.
x_ice_cream_maker.lore.legendary: Made ice cream so cold that the heatwave stopped for a scoop and went home in a cardigan.

x_juicer.lore.legendary: Squeezed a single lemon so hard that it filled a swimming pool, and every swimmer came out puckered.

x_stand_mixer.lore.rare: Kneads so stubbornly that it once kneaded the dough, the tea towel and a library book into one loaf.
x_stand_mixer.lore.legendary: Kneaded a dough so springy that the bread was used as the bouncy castle at the school fete.

bowl.lore.legendary: Was so deep that the cereal at the bottom was from last Tuesday, and a submarine was sent to fetch it.

x_colander.lore.legendary: Strained a whole river by accident while rinsing peas, and caught three fish, a wellington boot and a postcard.

x_colander_bowl.lore.epic: Sprayed rinse water through every hole at once, and the kitchen had its own rainbow for an hour.

x_sieve.lore.rare: Sifts so finely that it separates the sugar from the salt, the sand from the beach and the truth from a fib.
x_sieve.lore.epic: Was used to sift the nursery sandpit and found three lost shoes, a tooth and the teacher's car keys.

x_strainer.lore.rare: Catches so much that it once caught the teabag, the spoon and a ring that had been missing for a month.
x_strainer.lore.legendary: Strained a whole thunderstorm through its mesh, so the picnic only got tiny, polite raindrops.

x_coffee_grinder.lore.rare: Grinds so fine that the coffee dust gets into every crack, and the bread tastes of mornings for a week.
x_coffee_grinder.lore.epic: Ground beans so fast that the kitchen smelled like a cafe, and three strangers walked in and sat down to order.
x_coffee_grinder.lore.legendary: Ground beans so strong that the sleepiest teenager in the house got up before the alarm, made the bed and asked for jobs.

x_milk_frother.lore.rare: Froths anything it is dipped into, including the soup, the gravy and the bath.
x_milk_frother.lore.epic: Buzzed so fast in an empty jug that it spun across the counter, into the sink and frothed the washing-up.

x_soda_maker.lore.epic: Fizzed the water so hard that the bubbles lifted the bottle off the counter and it bobbed round the kitchen like a balloon.
x_soda_maker.lore.legendary: Fizzed the garden pond by accident, and the frogs have burped in harmony every evening since.

x_spice_grinder.lore.rare: Grinds pepper so hot that the plates sweat and the gravy asks for a glass of water.
x_spice_grinder.lore.legendary: Spiced a soup so fiercely that it boiled without the hob, and the hob took the evening off.

x_water_filter_jug.lore.rare: Filters so thoroughly that it takes out the taste, the smell and very nearly the water.
x_water_filter_jug.lore.epic: Filtered a paddling pool so clear that the children kept losing each other in it.
x_water_filter_jug.lore.legendary: Filtered a muddy puddle into water so clean that the puddle got a job as a mirror.

cutlery_fork.lore.legendary: Twirled spaghetti so hard that it wound up the bowl, the tablecloth and the cat's tail.

x_freezer_chest.lore.epic: Was defrosted at last, and out came three ice lollies, last winter's snowman and a very confused fish finger.

x_mini_fridge.lore.legendary: Held more snacks than the corner shop, and the corner shop now comes to it for supplies.

x_wine_cooler.lore.legendary: Stayed so calm and cool that the family started bringing their arguments to it, and it settles them by fogging up.

frying_pan.lore.rare: Grows a non-stick coat so slippery that the eggs slide off, across the floor and out of the cat flap.
frying_pan.lore.legendary: Fried an egg the size of a trampoline, and the children bounced on it until lunch.

knife.lore.epic: Carved a Sunday roast so neatly that the slices fanned out like a deck of cards, and grandad dealt them.
knife.lore.legendary: Buttered a slice of toast so smoothly from edge to edge that it was hung in a gallery.

x_bread_maker.lore.rare: Bakes a loaf in the shape of whatever it dreamed about, and last night it dreamed about a bicycle.
x_bread_maker.lore.epic: Added so much yeast that the dough climbed out, went down the hall and was found asleep on the sofa.
x_bread_maker.lore.legendary: Baked a loaf so fluffy that it floated up the chimney, and the birds have had breakfast in the clouds ever since.

x_bread_toaster_oven.lore.uncommon: Pings so quietly that the toast is always found cold an hour later.
x_bread_toaster_oven.lore.legendary: Toasted a crumpet so golden that the sunflowers in the garden turned to face it.

x_pizza_oven.lore.rare: Gets so hot that the pizza is done before anyone chooses a topping, so every pizza comes out plain.
x_pizza_oven.lore.epic: Baked pizzas so fast at a garden party that they stacked up to the bedroom window, and the cat ate from upstairs.

plate.lore.legendary: Was spun so well at a party that it is still spinning on top of the ceiling fan three summers later.

pot.lore.rare: Boils so hard that the soup bubbles over into the next pan, which then gets the blame.
pot.lore.epic: Bubbled a stew so thick that the wooden spoon stood up, waved and had to be pulled out with both hands.
pot.lore.legendary: Boiled a single potato so hard that it came out mashed, buttered and already on a plate.

i_potpie.lore.rare: Keeps its filling so hot that the first bite always turns into a small dragon impression.
i_potpie.lore.legendary: Grew so much pastry over its filling that the pie became a tent, and the family camped in it.

x_boiler.lore.uncommon: Needs its pressure topped up every week, and sulks with a red light until somebody does it.
x_boiler.lore.epic: Fired up so fiercely after a repair that every radiator rang like a bell and the towels dried in seconds.
x_boiler.lore.legendary: Heated the house so well one winter that the snow slid off the roof in one piece and landed as a snowman.

x_electric_blanket.lore.uncommon: Has a little control with three settings, and the family argues every night about which one.
x_electric_blanket.lore.rare: Warms only one side of the bed, so its owner wakes up half toast and half ice lolly.
x_electric_blanket.lore.epic: Was switched on by mistake in a heatwave, and the bed was used to rise bread dough for a week.
x_electric_blanket.lore.legendary: Warmed a bed so well that a hedgehog woke from hibernation in February, thought it was spring and went jogging.

x_electric_blanket_cover.lore.legendary: Kept a bed so warm that the frost on the window gave up and drew a palm tree instead.

x_electric_heater.lore.rare: Warms only the person furthest away, so everyone keeps swapping chairs all evening.
x_electric_heater.lore.legendary: Warmed a cold office so quickly that the penguins on the wall calendar asked for sun cream.

x_furnace.lore.epic: Roared on so hard in a cold snap that the cat's whiskers curled and the curtains stood out like flags all night.

x_gas_heater.lore.rare: Glows so cosily that every moth in the garden comes to sit under it like a tiny audience.
x_gas_heater.lore.legendary: Warmed a patio so well that the swallows decided not to fly south and stayed for the winter barbecues.

x_heating_pad.lore.epic: Was used to warm the car seat on a frosty morning, and the car refused to start until it had a turn too.
x_heating_pad.lore.legendary: Soothed a grumpy grandad's back so well that he danced at the bus stop and the bus waited to watch.

x_oil_heater.lore.legendary: Stayed warm so long that it was still cosy at the summer fete, where it melted every ice lolly in reach.

x_deep_fryer.lore.rare: Crisps chips so loudly that the smoke alarm, the doorbell and the dog all go off at once.

x_egg_cooker.lore.rare: Cooks eggs so precisely that it refuses to make a runny one for anybody who was rude to it.
x_egg_cooker.lore.legendary: Boiled an egg so perfectly that it hatched into a full cooked breakfast with toast soldiers.

x_pressure_cooker_unit.lore.epic: Let off steam so hard at teatime that the kitchen wallpaper peeled off and rolled itself up neatly.
x_pressure_cooker_unit.lore.legendary: Cooked dinner so fast that it was served the night before, and the family ate it twice.

rice_cooker.lore.rare: Clicks to warm mode the moment anyone lifts the lid, then starts again from the beginning out of spite.
rice_cooker.lore.legendary: Cooked rice so sticky that the family built a snowman out of it and still had plenty left for dinner.

x_slow_cooker_unit.lore.epic: Cooked so slowly that the carrots planted in the garden that morning grew up in time to join the stew.
x_slow_cooker_unit.lore.legendary: Made a stew so tender that it fell apart, then fell back together as a perfect pie.

x_steamer.lore.uncommon: Steams up the cook's glasses every time the lid comes off, so dinner is served by feel.
x_steamer.lore.legendary: Steamed a pudding so light that it rose out of the basket and was caught by the washing line.

x_yogurt_maker.lore.rare: Turns any milk left near it into yoghurt overnight, including the cat's saucer and the cereal.
x_yogurt_maker.lore.epic: Made so much yoghurt in one week that the fridge had to be emptied of everything else, including the light.
x_yogurt_maker.lore.legendary: Made a yoghurt so creamy that the cows came to the window to ask how it was done.

x_boxing_glove.lore.common: Is so puffy that its wearer cannot open a door, a crisp packet or a bottle of water.
x_boxing_glove.lore.legendary: Punched the air so hard that it knocked a cloud into a new shape, and the weather map had to be redrawn.

x_oven_mitt.lore.rare: Is so thick that its wearer can lift a hot tray but cannot let go of it, so trays get carried round for ages.
x_oven_mitt.lore.epic: Was used as a puppet at a dinner party, and the puppet told everyone the roast was late.
x_oven_mitt.lore.legendary: Lifted the whole oven out of the wall to reach one biscuit that had fallen down the back.

spatula.lore.epic: Flipped a pancake so hard that it wrapped itself round the lampshade, and the kitchen glowed golden.
spatula.lore.legendary: Flipped an omelette so high that it came down folded, filled and with a sprig of parsley on top.

x_popcorn_maker.lore.rare: Butters the popcorn so generously that the bowl slides across the table on its own.
x_popcorn_maker.lore.legendary: Popped a single kernel so big that the cinema now uses it as a spare seat.

x_sandwich_toaster.lore.epic: Pressed a toastie so flat that it was posted to a cousin abroad in an ordinary envelope.
x_sandwich_toaster.lore.legendary: Pressed a toastie so hard that the cheese turned into a diamond, and the family still argues about who eats it.

whisk.lore.uncommon: Keeps one lump of batter trapped inside its loops where no tap can reach.
whisk.lore.legendary: Whisked the duck pond by accident, and the ducks came out as fluffy as meringues.

x_baking_dish.lore.rare: Holds its heat so long that the lasagne is still bubbling at bedtime, so seconds have to wait until morning.
x_baking_dish.lore.legendary: Baked a lasagne with so many layers that it was mistaken for a building and given a postcode.

x_baking_tray.lore.rare: Bakes everything to the shape of its warp, so every biscuit comes out curved like a crisp.
x_baking_tray.lore.legendary: Baked a single biscuit the size of a car park, and the school used it as a playground for a week.

x_barbecue.lore.epic: Sent smoke so thick over a street party that the guests played hide-and-seek in it, and the winner is still hiding.
x_barbecue.lore.legendary: Grilled a sausage so long that it was used as a skipping rope at the school fete.

x_bath_mat.lore.epic: Was stepped on by the whole family after a muddy football match and now keeps five footprints that never wash out.

x_bathroom_scale.lore.uncommon: Beeps loudly at three in the morning whenever the cat walks across it.
x_bathroom_scale.lore.rare: Weighs holiday suitcases so honestly that every trip starts with three jumpers worn at once.
x_bathroom_scale.lore.epic: Was used as a stepping stone across a flooded bathroom, and now beeps nervously whenever it hears a tap.

x_bottle_opener.lore.epic: Opened every bottle at a picnic at once, and the fizz lifted the tablecloth like a hovercraft.
x_bottle_opener.lore.legendary: Opened a stuck jar, a stuck window and a stuck conversation at one family dinner.

x_butter_dish.lore.epic: Kept the butter so hard in winter that the toast tore, the knife bent and the toaster went on strike.
x_butter_dish.lore.legendary: Softened its butter so perfectly that a slice of toast slid out of the house and all the way to the bus stop.

x_cake_tin.lore.rare: Springs its clip open whenever it hears the word cake, ready or not.
x_cake_tin.lore.legendary: Baked a birthday cake so tall that the family needed the lift in the block of flats to reach the icing.

x_can_opener.lore.legendary: Cranked round a can so many times that it opened the can, the cupboard and the corner shop's shutter.

x_casserole_dish.lore.epic: Was so heavy at a family dinner that the table bowed in the middle and the peas rolled down to grandad.
x_casserole_dish.lore.legendary: Was so heavy that it sank through the kitchen floor into the cellar, still bubbling, and the cellar has smelled of dinner ever since.

x_chafing_dish.lore.epic: Lifted its lid at a hotel buffet so dramatically that a hundred tourists photographed the beans.
x_chafing_dish.lore.legendary: Kept a tray of sausages warm for so long that they became a local landmark with a little sign.

x_cheese_board.lore.legendary: Held a cheese so strong that the party moved outside, then down the road, then to the next town.

x_cheese_grater.lore.rare: Keeps the tastiest cheese shreds for itself and only hands over the dry ones.
x_cheese_grater.lore.legendary: Grated a carrot so finely that the shreds were planted and grew back as forty carrots.

x_chopsticks.lore.legendary: Caught every grain of a dropped bowl of rice before a single one reached the floor.

x_crepe_pan.lore.rare: Spreads the batter so wide that the crepe flops over the edge and onto the cook's slippers.
x_crepe_pan.lore.epic: Made a crepe so wide at a party that it was used as a tablecloth, then eaten for dessert.
x_crepe_pan.lore.legendary: Swirled its batter so fast that the crepe wrapped round the whole kitchen, and the cook had to eat his way out.

x_cutting_board.lore.rare: Keeps the smell of every onion ever cut on it, so the fruit salad always makes people cry.
x_cutting_board.lore.epic: Was taken to the beach as a surfboard and rode a wave all the way into the ice-cream queue.

x_dog_bowl.lore.common: Slops water over the edge every time the dog drinks, so the kitchen floor is always a small pond.
x_dog_bowl.lore.rare: Gets buried in the garden by the dog whenever it holds the wrong dinner, and dug up again for the right one.
x_dog_bowl.lore.epic: Was carried by the dog to a picnic three fields away, and the picnickers filled it out of politeness.

x_doormat.lore.epic: Said WELCOME so convincingly that a lost sheep, two tortoises and the postman's dog came in for tea.
x_doormat.lore.legendary: Kept a house so clean that the hoover took early retirement and moved to the seaside.

x_exercise_mat.lore.rare: Counts every sit-up out loud, and never counts the last one, so the workout never ends.
x_exercise_mat.lore.legendary: Was used for so many star jumps in one morning that the ceiling below grew a crack shaped like a star.

x_yoga_mat.lore.legendary: Taught a whole family to touch their toes, including a grandad who had not seen his own since the moon landing.

x_fondue_pot.lore.rare: Bubbles so thickly that every fork comes out trailing a cheese string as long as the table.
x_fondue_pot.lore.legendary: Held a cheese so deep that a fork lost at a party two winters ago came back up, still holding its bread.

x_fruit_bowl.lore.uncommon: Collects keys, coins and one sock until there is no room left for fruit.
x_fruit_bowl.lore.rare: Hides the last banana under the apples, so everyone eats an apple and the banana goes brown.
x_fruit_bowl.lore.legendary: Turned a single lemon into a lemon tree overnight, and now the kitchen needs a ladder at breakfast.

x_funnel.lore.uncommon: Gets used as a megaphone by whoever finds it first, usually to announce dinner.
x_funnel.lore.rare: Pours everything into the wrong bottle, so the squash tastes of vinegar and the vinegar tastes of squash.
x_funnel.lore.legendary: Poured a whole rainstorm into one watering can, and the garden was watered for the summer.

x_garlic_press.lore.rare: Squeezes garlic so hard that it shoots across the room and sticks to the window.
x_garlic_press.lore.epic: Jammed shut on a clove and took the whole family pulling on both handles like a tug of war.

x_griddle.lore.legendary: Fried a breakfast so wide that the sausages had to be turned by a team on bicycles.

x_grill.lore.legendary: Grilled cheese so fast that it melted before it was sliced, and the slices dropped straight onto the toast.

x_hot_plate.lore.legendary: Cooked a whole wedding banquet on one ring, one pan at a time, and the guests had the main course at breakfast.

x_induction_hob.lore.rare: Refuses to heat any pan it has not been introduced to, so the cook has to say the pan's name first.
x_induction_hob.lore.epic: Switched on its child lock during dinner, and the whole family stood round the cold soup hunting for the right button.

x_kettle_grill.lore.rare: Rolls across the patio on its little legs whenever the wind blows, chasing the guests round the garden.
x_kettle_grill.lore.epic: Shut its lid so tightly on the burgers that the family had to sing to it before it would open again.
x_kettle_grill.lore.legendary: Was mistaken for a giant beetle by a flock of starlings, who now follow it wherever it rolls.

x_kitchen_scale.lore.epic: Weighed the flour so honestly that it refused to round down, and the cake recipe now has decimal points.
x_kitchen_scale.lore.legendary: Weighed a cloud by holding a bowl out of the window, and the weather forecast now quotes it.

x_lazy_susan.lore.legendary: Spun so fast at a banquet that every guest ended up with someone else's dinner, and nobody wanted to swap back.

x_measuring_cup_tool.lore.rare: Measures everything slightly wrong in its own favour, so every cake comes out a little bigger.
x_measuring_cup_tool.lore.legendary: Measured out a cup of sunshine for a recipe, and the cake stayed warm in the middle all winter.

x_mixing_bowl_metal.lore.epic: Caught the sun on the windowsill and beamed it into the neighbour's lounge, so they have been waving back for a week.
x_mixing_bowl_metal.lore.legendary: Mixed a batter so smooth that the cake came out with the baker's reflection in the icing.

x_mortar_and_pestle.lore.epic: Pounded spices so hard that the counter cracked, the kettle jumped and the curry was ready before the rice.
x_mortar_and_pestle.lore.legendary: Ground up a pebble that fell in by mistake so finely that the family used it as birthday glitter.

x_pestle.lore.legendary: Pounded so hard at a festival stall that it struck oil, and the stall sold salad dressing all afternoon.

x_mouse_pad.lore.legendary: Was so smooth that the mouse slid off the desk, out of the window and was found clicking in the next town.

x_muffin_tin.lore.epic: Baked muffins so tall that they leaned on each other and toppled off the windowsill like dominoes.
x_muffin_tin.lore.legendary: Baked a single muffin so big that the school now uses its top as the roof of the bandstand.

x_nail_clippers.lore.common: Click so sharply that the cat leaves the room every time they come out of the drawer.
x_nail_clippers.lore.rare: Clip so fast that one hand is finished before its owner notices, and the other hand gets jealous.
x_nail_clippers.lore.legendary: Were dropped in the garden and trimmed every hedge in the street, and the gardener is still confused.

x_nutcracker.lore.legendary: Cracked a walnut so cleanly that the garden frogs now use both halves as boats.

x_paella_pan.lore.epic: Was too wide for the kitchen door, so the party was cooked on the lawn just as the sprinklers came on.
x_paella_pan.lore.legendary: Cooked a paella so big that the crispy bottom was rolled up and used as a picnic blanket.

x_pet_food_bowl.lore.rare: Hides the best biscuits at the very bottom, so the dog flips it over every single time to find them.
x_pet_food_bowl.lore.epic: Was filled so high at teatime that the cat, the dog and the hamster had to agree a rota.
x_pet_food_bowl.lore.legendary: Got the dog and the cat to share one meal, and the peace treaty is framed on the fridge.

x_pie_dish.lore.uncommon: Has a little china bird in the middle that whistles when the pie is done, usually during the news.
x_pie_dish.lore.legendary: Baked a pie with a crust so high that it had its own weather, and it rained apple juice inside.

x_potato_masher.lore.epic: Mashed so hard at a roast dinner that the table jumped, the peas rolled off and the gravy boat set sail.
x_potato_masher.lore.legendary: Mashed a whole sack of potatoes into one smooth cloud, and the family napped on it after lunch.

x_ramekin.lore.rare: Holds exactly one portion and not a spoonful more, so every second helping ends up on the tablecloth.
x_ramekin.lore.legendary: Held a custard so wobbly that it set off the earthquake alarm at the museum next door.

x_roasting_tin.lore.epic: Roasted potatoes so crunchy that the crunch set off the smoke alarm, which then asked for one.
x_roasting_tin.lore.legendary: Roasted a parsnip so crispy that it kept crunching for a whole minute after it was swallowed.

x_salad_bowl_wooden.lore.uncommon: Has soaked up so much dressing over the years that every salad tastes a little of last summer.
x_salad_bowl_wooden.lore.rare: Sprouts a tiny new leaf from its own wood every spring, and nobody knows what tree it thinks it is.
x_salad_bowl_wooden.lore.epic: Floated off down the river at a picnic, still full of salad, and the ducks had a very healthy lunch.
x_salad_bowl_wooden.lore.legendary: Grew back into a tree overnight, and now the salad is served from its branches.

x_salad_spinner.lore.rare: Spins so hard that the lettuce comes out dizzy and refuses to lie flat on the plate.
x_salad_spinner.lore.legendary: Spun so fast that it took off from the counter and was spotted circling the garden like a flying saucer.

x_saucepan_lid.lore.rare: Steams up so thickly that the cook cannot see into the pan and pours custard into the gravy.
x_saucepan_lid.lore.epic: Was used as a shield in a kitchen pillow fight and blocked a whole flying trifle.

x_scale.lore.rare: Adds a little weight to anything it dislikes, so the sprouts always weigh twice as much as the chocolate.

x_serving_bowl.lore.rare: Never fits in any cupboard, so it lives on top of the fridge and drops on whoever opens the door.
x_serving_bowl.lore.epic: Was passed round a family dinner so fast that it went twice round the table and once round the garden.
x_serving_bowl.lore.legendary: Was passed round a wedding table so many times that it ended up married to the gravy boat.

x_serving_tray.lore.rare: Catches the light so brightly that whoever carries it is dazzled and walks into the door.
x_serving_tray.lore.epic: Was used as a sledge on the first snow day and beat the next-door toboggan to the bottom of the hill.
x_serving_tray.lore.legendary: Carried breakfast in bed so smoothly that the boiled egg stayed asleep the whole way.

x_smoker.lore.uncommon: Needs feeding with wood chips every hour, and grumbles smoke at whoever forgets.
x_smoker.lore.legendary: Smoked a cheese so slowly that it grew a beard and started telling stories.

x_steamer_basket.lore.rare: Steams so gently that the dumplings fall asleep inside and have to be woken for dinner.
x_steamer_basket.lore.legendary: Stacked itself so high for a family feast that the top basket had to be served by the window cleaner.

x_stock_pot.lore.epic: Was so big that a toddler used it as a boat in the garden, with the cat as captain.
x_stock_pot.lore.legendary: Made a stock so rich that one spoonful turned the garden pond into soup, and the frogs asked for bread rolls.

x_stove_top.lore.uncommon: Has one knob that always works the wrong ring, so the empty pan heats up and the soup stays cold.
x_stove_top.lore.epic: Cooked four dinners at once for four fussy eaters, and all four swapped plates at the table.

x_sugar_bowl_dish.lore.uncommon: Attracts one ant every morning, who brings a friend, who brings a cousin.
x_sugar_bowl_dish.lore.rare: Makes any tea it touches so sweet that the teaspoon starts to dissolve.
x_sugar_bowl_dish.lore.epic: Was emptied into the salt cellar by mistake, and the chips at dinner tasted like doughnuts.
x_sugar_bowl_dish.lore.legendary: Sweetened a lemon so thoroughly that it now insists on being called an orange.

x_tagine.lore.rare: Points its tall lid at whoever is hungriest, and it is never wrong.
x_tagine.lore.epic: Was mistaken for a wizard hat at a fancy-dress party and worn all night, stew and all.
x_tagine.lore.legendary: Kept its lid on so long that the stew inside invented a new spice and named it after itself.

x_tongs.lore.epic: Clacked so hungrily at a seaside barbecue that every crab on the beach clacked back.
x_tongs.lore.legendary: Lifted a whole garden table to fetch one sausage that had rolled under it, and the guests kept eating.

x_tweezers.lore.epic: Picked up every grain of spilt glitter after a birthday party, one at a time, until breakfast.
x_tweezers.lore.legendary: Pulled a splinter out of a tree so gently that the tree said thank you with an apple.
